title: Ecosystem Worth Reflection
opening: Look around before you decide what anything is for. What people, things, and systems are here?

labels.focusPrompt: Choose one way to use the tree, or keep the whole place in view.
labels.scene: A tree with visible roots, trunk, branches, leaves, water, and ground.
labels.note: What did your chosen purpose bring into view? What may still matter outside it?

lenses.label: Keep the whole place in view
lenses.message: No single use is selected. The roots, trunk, branches, leaves, water, and ground stay in view.
lenses.figureLabel: Whole tree scene with roots, trunk, branches, leaves, water, and ground in view.

lenses.label: Use its shade
lenses.message: Roots, leaves, and water stand out. The trunk, branches, and ground recede. This is one view of the tree as shelter from the sun.
lenses.figureLabel: Shade view: roots, leaves, and water stand out; trunk, branches, and ground remain visible but are muted.

lenses.label: Use its material
lenses.message: The trunk, branches, and twigs stand out. Roots, leaves, water, and ground recede in this material view.
lenses.figureLabel: Material view: trunk, branches, and twigs stand out; roots, leaves, water, and ground remain visible but are muted.

teaching.shadeExample: You can sit in a tree's shade without turning it into a content opportunity. Shade may be useful, but it is not the only reason to notice the tree.
teaching.engineeringComparison: Engineering analysis can be useful for a chosen task. It does not have to be the only way you view a place.
teaching.practiceLead: Think of a place or conversation you know. Notice what is there before you decide what it is for.

practice.result: What did your first purpose make easier to notice? What else could matter in the same encounter?

feedback.unavailable: Private notes cannot be saved here. Your note remains on screen.
feedback.missing: Write a short note before saving. You can leave any part of the reflection unfinished.
feedback.length: Shorten the note to 2,000 characters or fewer.
feedback.readFailure: The saved note could not be loaded. Your current note remains here.
feedback.conflict: This note changed elsewhere. Your answer remains here; compare before saving again.
feedback.readbackFailure: The save could not be confirmed. Retry to check the same save.
feedback.saveFailure: The save is uncertain. Retry the same note.
feedback.retryPending: The earlier save is unresolved. Retry the same note before changing it.

source.attribution: Supplied manuscript; authorship/adoption of every wording is not independently established.
